step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an automated severe weather warning dissemination system for the Met Office. A CloudWatch Event regularly triggers AWS Step Functions, which orchestrates Lambda tasks. Step Functions queries the internal Warning API (ApiGateway) to verify if an active warning exists. If active, it stores the warning state as a JSON object in an S3 bucket, retrieves responder preferences from a second S3 bucket (periodically updated from On-Premise systems), merges the data, and sends alerts via a third-party Messaging API.
